messages:
sam_support: Hey team — customer reports embedding size changed after we pinned a new variant yesterday. They see 1536 dims but expect 1024. Impacting search scoring, customer is in prod. Logs attached below.

ops-bot: system: pinned variant change: model=embed-fast, old_variant=embed-fast@v1.2.3, new_variant=embed-fast@v2.0.0, by=anya_eng, at=2026-03-08T18:12:10Z

anya_eng: thanks for the heads up. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) + one full response showing the vector length? Also which customer and workspace id so we can correlate logs.

sam_support: repro below — customer provided this exact request and response (redacted keys):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"embed-fast","input":["search query 1","search query 2"]}'
```
Response (trimmed):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,0.234,...],"index":0},{"embedding":[0.002,0.123,...],"index":1}],"meta":{"model":"embed-fast@v2.0.0","embedding_width":1536}}
```
They say when they set variant pin back to v1.2.3 or use `?variant=embed-fast@v1.2.3` they get 1024 vectors. This started immediately after the pinned change.

ravi_ml: interesting — two quick hypotheses: 1) model v2 was onboarded from a different checkpoint with 1536 embed dim and got pinned globally, 2) there is a catalog->runtime mapping bug where the quantized variant alias points to a different model binary under heavy batching (batch >1) due to a variant alias collision.

anya_eng: check serving logs for model load entries and for the request routing trace for a sample request. Sam, can you share a trace id from the customer's failing request?

sam_support: trace id: trc_20260308_9b4f2c. I pulled serving lines around it: 
```
[2026-03-08T18:19:03Z] router: route req id=trc_20260308_9b4f2c -> pool=dedicated-eu, model=embed-fast@v2.0.0
[2026-03-08T18:19:03Z] runtime: loaded model_binary=embed-fast_v2_quant4.bin embed_width=1536
[2026-03-08T18:19:03Z] runtime: batch size=2, continuous_batching=enabled
[2026-03-08T18:19:03Z] runtime: response sizes=[1536,1536] tokens=...\n```
Looks like the runtime really loaded a 1536 width binary.

ravi_ml: that log nails it — v2 binary is 1536. We need to check model-catalog entry for embed-fast@v2.0.0. I remember a conversion script replaced a 1024 checkpoint with an experimental 1536 one without updating metadata. I'll open a quick check.

anya_eng: mitigation plan: 1) immediately unpin embed-fast for the affected workspace or globally revert pin to v1.2.3 (rollback) 2) add a temporary router rule to force variant embed-fast@v1.2.3 for the customer's workspace, 3) engineering to validate model-catalog metadata and add an assert that binary.embed_width == metadata.embed_width at load time. Who can do the rollback now?

jen_oncall: I can rollback the pin for that workspace and add a routing override. Creating incident INC-20260308-embed-dim and will notify customer. Will need the workspace id — can you paste?

sam_support: workspace id: ws_prod_8421. Customer impact: degraded search relevance for ~90% of queries since 18:12 UTC. They want ETA to fix.

ravi_ml: I'll open PR to add a model load-time assert and a catalog lint check. Patch: enforce embed_dim match and fail fast if mismatch; will include alerting. PR draft #4521. Also will add a quick script to scan recent model uploads for inconsistent metadata.

anya_eng: Sam/Jen — after rollback please capture a full failing request/response and the corresponding log lines for the v2 load so we can repro in staging. Also note whether the issue reproduces only when batch>1. That would indicate a batching alias collision, otherwise it's purely model binary metadata.

sam_support: rollback applied for workspace ws_prod_8421 at 18:34 UTC, router override added to force embed-fast@v1.2.3. Customer says vectors now 1024 again. They still want root cause and prevention.

ops-bot: system: incident INC-20260308-embed-dim created by jen_oncall at 2026-03-08T18:37:10Z

ravi_ml: quick follow-up — scanned catalog: embed-fast@v2.0.0 metadata.embed_width=1024 but binary embed_width=1536. So metadata lied. Likely onboarding script had a stray symlink. I'll trace upload logs and the person who published v2 (uploader: ml_onboard_bot).

anya_eng: good catch. Next actions: 1) ravi to finish PR #4521 and run catalog scan (urgent), 2) infra to block publish if metadata mismatch (chore), 3) outreach: jen to send customer postmortem with timeline and mitigation steps.

jen_oncall: pinging customer with status and rollback note. Will include ETA for permanent fix once PR passes review.

sam_support: customer acknowledged rollback and wants confirmation when the patch is in.

anya_eng: assigning to ravi_ml for the PR, I'll schedule a short postmortem sync. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
